name: rpd
description: RPD — Rapid Product Document. An AI-agent-agnostic skill covering the full project lifecycle: requirement diagnosis, PRD generation, project state management, security scanning, intent routing, decision drift detection, and cross-session progress recovery. Supports Chinese and English.
description_zh: RPD — 快速产品文档。面向任意 AI 工具的 Agent Skill：覆盖需求诊断、PRD 生成、项目状态管理、安全扫描、意图路由、决策漂移检测、跨会话进度恢复。支持中英文。
